resources.string: Pause live TV, then pick up where you left off.
Where rewind is saved while you watch. Applies from the next channel change.
Can\'t reach %1$s: saving on this device for now.
Sign in needed for %1$s: saving on this device for now.
Where rewind is saved while you watch.
A shared folder on a computer or NAS (SMB)
Slow: rewind may stop now and then
%1$s kept dropping out. The Box tries it again in a few minutes.
Rewind will save to this device.
Connect the drive, then try again.
Rewind will save to %1$s, from the next channel change.
Computers on your network that share folders.

Check the computer is on and file sharing is turned on (on Windows: set this network to Private).\nIf The Box is on a guest Wi-Fi, connect it to your main Wi-Fi. Or enter the computer\'s name or address.
Allow local network access in it (sometimes called LAN access or split tunnelling),\nor pause it, so The Box can see computers at home.
Type the computer and its password on your phone.
This computer didn\'t list its shared folders.
%1$s has no shared folders to show.
Use this if the shared folder isn\'t listed above.
There\'s no shared folder \"%1$s\" on %2$s. Check the name and try again.
Use an account on that computer.
Scan a code and type the password on your phone.
Add a network folder from your phone
Leave empty unless you know you need it.
On Windows, use the user name and password of an account on that PC. A separate local account for The Box is a safer choice than your main sign-in.\nOn a Mac, use the Mac\'s user name and password.
No keyboard on this TV: sign in from your phone, or use a folder that allows guests.
Signed in to %1$s. Choose the folder on the TV.
%1$s didn\'t accept that user name or password. Check them and send again.
%1$s doesn\'t allow guests. Enter a user name and password, then send again.
Your account can\'t open this shared folder on %1$s. Choose another one, or give your account access on %1$s, then send again.
Can\'t reach %1$s (%2$s). Check it\'s on and on the same network, then send again.
There\'s no folder \"%1$s\" in %2$s. Choose one below.
No folders in here. Use this folder, or go up.
The top of the shared folder
4K channels may stop saving now and then. A wired connection to %1$s helps.
A wired connection, or a Wi-Fi router closer to this TV, helps. You can still use it.
Rewind would often stop. Use this device instead, or improve the connection to %1$s.
The drive took %1$s s to wake up. The Box wakes it when you open the TV, so rewind isn\'t affected.
On this TV, short network drops stop rewind for the channel.
Check it\'s on and on the same network, then try again.
A VPN app is on: allow local network access in it.
%1$s only speaks an old file-sharing version (SMB1), which The Box doesn\'t support.
Turn on SMB2 or SMB3 in its settings.
%1$s didn\'t accept that user name or password.
On a Mac, also tick this user under File Sharing → Options → Windows File Sharing.
Sign in with a user name and password.
Your account can\'t open this folder on %1$s.
Choose another folder, or give your account access on %1$s.
Your account can read this folder but can\'t save to it.
Choose another folder, or give your account write access on %1$s.
Guests can open this folder on %1$s but can\'t save to it.
Sign in with a user name and password, or allow guests to write on %1$s.
This device isn\'t connected to a network.
Free up space or choose another folder.
Try again, or choose another folder.
Rewind is saving on this device: %1$s isn\'t answering. Check it\'s on, or change Settings → Playback → Pause and rewind → Save to.
Rewind is saving on this device: %1$s needs you to sign in again. Sign in at Settings → Playback → Pause and rewind → Save to → %1$s.
Rewind is saving on this device for now: %1$s kept dropping out. The Box tries %1$s again in a few minutes.
Rewind is saving on this device: the USB drive isn\'t connected. Connect it, or change Settings → Playback → Pause and rewind → Save to.
Rewind is saving on this device: %1$s is almost full. Free up space there, or change Settings → Playback → Pause and rewind → Save to.
Rewind is saving on this device: the USB drive is full. Free up space there, or change Settings → Playback → Pause and rewind → Save to.
Rewind stopped: %1$s stopped answering. Live TV continues; from your next channel change, rewind saves on this device until %1$s is back.
%1$s stopped answering, so you\'re back at live. Live TV continues; rewind saves on this device from your next channel change.
Rewind stopped: %1$s is full. Live TV continues. Free up space there, or change Settings → Playback → Pause and rewind → Save to.
Rewind stopped: %1$s no longer lets The Box save there. Live TV continues. Check the folder\'s permissions, then choose Test this folder in Settings → Playback → Pause and rewind → Save to → %1$s.
Rewind stopped: the saved file on %1$s was deleted. Live TV continues; change channel and back to start again.
Rewind stopped: the USB drive was removed. Live TV continues; rewind saves on this device from your next channel change.
Rewind stopped: %1$s couldn\'t keep up over your network. Live TV continues; from your next channel change, rewind saves on this device for a while.
Rewind stopped: the USB drive can\'t keep up with this channel. Live TV continues. A faster drive helps, or choose This device in Settings → Playback → Pause and rewind → Save to.
Saving for rewind failed on %1$s, so Play returns to live.
%1$s stopped answering while you were paused, so you\'re back at live. Rewind saves on this device from your next channel change.
